{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.12

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns array with how much vehicle needs repairing, refueling and rearming.

|s1= [[needService]] vehicle

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [repair, refuel, rearm]. Values are in range 0..1: 0: no need, 1: maximum need

|x1= <sqf>needService tank params ["_needRepair", "_needRefuel", "_needRearm"];</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>onEachFrame { hintSilent str needService vehicle player };</sqf>

|seealso= [[allowService]] [[allowedService]] [[needReload]]
}}
